issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-8149](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-8149)
### Description

DMLs on temp tables execute PG code paths for transaction handling. 
DDLs don't, with an exception of `CTAS` (and `ALTER TYPE` after https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/18911 is fixed). We should probably set all DDLs to use PG code paths (so that we don't miss cases like `ALTER TYPE`), and additionally also add more tests for temp table DDLs.
